# genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits_workplanrotation (Data Source)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/data-sources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud workforce management management unit work plan rotation data source. Select a work plan rotation by name

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this data source. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/managementunits/{managementUnitId}/workplanrotations/{workPlanRotationId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-managementunits--managementUnitId--workplanrotations--workPlanRotationId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `wfm:agent:view`
* `wfm:workPlanRotation:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `workforce-management`
* `workforce-management:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits_workplanrotation" "weekly_rotation" {
  management_unit_id = genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits.contact_center.id
  name               = "Weekly Rotation"
}
```
